verdict.rationale: CloudConvert is an API-first service, so it runs headlessly by design. It documents official SDKs in six languages, scoped API keys for non-interactive auth, and a sandbox API with unlimited jobs that suits CI testing. Multi-step jobs can import from and export to S3, 429 responses include Retry-After, and fixed LibreOffice versions keep runs reproducible. missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-specific integration docs (e.g., GitHub Actions examples), independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
